correctness.rationale: The Con et al. affine-equality lemma at length 5>2(3−1) makes 60 normalized tuples 01abc with distinct a,b,c∈{2,3,4,5,6} all distinct codes. Pairwise intersection equals the common 1-line iff exact rank over F7 of (1,a,a²,b,b²) equals 5. Independent enumeration used a separate determinant formulation and networkx maximal-clique algorithm, reproducing 1200 edges, 40-regular graph and maximal clique histogram {6:30,7:1920,8:5070,9:1800,10:138}; all max cliques are 10. Every monomial map of a ten-code family preserves the intersection of all petals, forcing all diagonal entries to be equal and reducing equivalence exactly to S5. Independent enumeration of all 120 coordinate permutations gives five orbits sizes 6,12,30,30,60 with stabilizers 20,10,4,4,2. Source exact verifier also computes element-order fingerprints identifying AGL(1,5), D10, C4, C4, C2; those group identifications follow from the complete explicit S5 permutation stabilizers.
